contract: -r prints null for a missing field; alt(x, EMPTY) prints nothing
-e exits 1 on false and null, 4 on no output, 0 on true; invalid JSON exits 2; a throwing expression exits 5
eq(x, null) holds for a missing field and for an explicit null
line-delimited input is read value by value; a broken line stops with exit 2 after earlier output
output already written reaches a pipe in full when a later value fails
num turns decimal numeric strings into numbers and rejects others, including 0x10
-R -s yields the whole input; the touched list expression gives [] for empty and one item per line
reading an argument that was not passed exits 5; a name such as __proto__ is an ordinary argument
default output is jq-style two-space JSON; -c is one line
a 40000-character stderr line and 3000 touched files reach report.json through stdin
